confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Sri Lankan tourist-town prices. No live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant anchors are moderately uncertain. Accommodation and imported-alcohol anchors are the least certain. Cocktail and wine were set from the local beer relationship because direct knowledge is weak. FX: the 0.6955 figure came from a search summary of RBA data, and I did not open the RBA page directly. A third-party page showed 0.6947 for 16 October 2026, so verify the RBA table before relying on the exact rate.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is Sri Lanka's Cultural Triangle tourist towns, such as Dambulla and Kandy, adjusted for Sigiriya being a smaller village-scale hub with fewer mid-range options.
